Bash("
- Input mode section was being rendered even after submission, causing duplicate ID

Root Cause:
- Missing logic to display saved resubmission data after submission
- No code to populate fields with saved values
- No conditional check to prevent rendering input mode section after submission
- Duplicate ID "resubmission-info-section" caused browser to show first \(hidden\) instance

Solution:
- Add conditional rendering for submitted resubmission data
- Display resubmission section with saved values when decision is submitted
- Show fields in read-only mode \(disabled inputs, display divs\)
- Display resubmission status and attempt number
- Wrap input mode section in !chairSubmitted condition to prevent duplicate

Changes:
- professor-v3/assets/js/review-detail.js
  * Add getTemplateName\(\) helper function to return template name from ID
  * Add check for result.resubmission after chairComment textarea
  * Render resubmission info section with saved data when chairSubmitted
  * Display reviewer type, evaluation template, deadline in readonly mode
  * Show status and attempt number
  * Wrap input mode resubmission section in !chairSubmitted condition
  * Remove $disabledAttr from input mode to avoid undefined errors

- test-resubmission-display.py \(new file\)
  * Automated test for resubmission display after submission
  * Verifies section visibility, content, and readonly mode
  * All tests pass

Test results:
- ✅ Section exists: True
- ✅ Display: block
- ✅ Visible: True
- ✅ Has content: True
- ✅ Is readonly: True
- ✅ All resubmission data fields displayed correctly

EOF
